rows.final:
I ran out of step budget before applying fixes. Findings from reading SPEC.md and the sources — every module violates its invariant:

- `tax.with_tax`: uses `// 100` (truncating, wrong divisor) instead of `(cents*rate_bp + 5000) // 10000`.
- `dates.days_between`: adds `+ 1`; should be `abs((b - a).days)`.
- `money.split`: returns `[cents // n] * n`, which loses the remainder; needs remainder distribution and `ValueError` for `n <= 0`.
- `text.normalize`: only lowercases; lacks collapsing non-`[a-z0-9]` runs to spaces and stripping.
- `stats.median`: always returns the upper middle element; needs even-length mean (float) and `ValueError` on empty.
- `sequence.unique`: uses `set`, losing first-seen order; needs order-preserving dedup.
- `parse.ints`: `int(token)` raises on non-integer tokens; should ignore invalid tokens.
- `window.chunks`: `range(n)` yields `n` chunks of wrong size and no `ValueError` for `n <= 0`; should step by `n`.
- `names.ext`: returns the whole name when there is no dot; should return `""`.
- `rounding.round_half_up`: `int(x)` truncates; should be `math.floor(x + 0.5)`.

No files were modified.
